name: claude-code-security-plugins
description: Automated security scanning (Bandit, Semgrep, Trivy, TruffleHog, Gitleaks, CodeQL, mcps-audit, OSV-Scanner, mcp-scan, mcp-exfil-scan, skillspector) and comprehensive static security review agent for Claude Code · OWASP APTS-aligned (Auditability, Manipulation Resistance, Reporting, Scope Enforcement). Ships PreToolUse secret-scan + catastrophic-command guard hooks and a /security-scan command.

secret_scan.title: Block writes that introduce secrets
secret_scan.description: PreToolUse hook runs gitleaks on pending Write/Edit content and blocks the write if a hardcoded secret is detected. Fails open on any tool/scanner error.

bash_guard.title: Block catastrophic Bash commands
bash_guard.description: PreToolUse hook blocks a narrow set of irreversibly destructive commands (rm -rf / | ~, mkfs, dd to a raw device, fork bombs, pipe-to-shell installers). Fails open on any error.
